verdict.rationale: Ramp evidences per-vendor/card spending limits, spend programs backing budgets, entity-level restrictions, and dynamic approval routing, which support department/program-level enforced spend limits (ramp-docs-31, ramp-docs-14, ramp-docs-16, ramp-supp-agent-cards mentions 'spend programs — back agent purchases with recurring-budget templates'). However there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'department/program budget' object with automatic threshold enforcement (e.g., budget vs. actual tracking, alerts on approaching budget caps) beyond per-card/vendor limits. missing for 10: explicit department/program-level budget-setting UI/API with automated overspend blocking, budget-vs-actual reporting, and independent/community confirmation of budget enforcement in practice.
